rna.text: Zita runs an effigy shop where Kodolaag clumsily tries to chat her up and learns from her that effigy spells used on Azorius senators are now punishable by imprisonment.

Zita fears arrest when Kodolaag uses blight parchment to drive an Azorius elocutor away, though Kodolaag persuades Olrich to host her effigy sales at the Mockturne, and on the way home she is arrested for fixing graffiti insulting Dovin Baan.

Kodolaag finds Zita under an Azorius spell that makes prisoners praise their imprisonment, and Zita brings a guard's drawing to life while Kodolaag draws every guard on blight parchment and tears the pages, and Olrich impersonates Dovin Baan to hold off a soldier.

Jitka Wothis and a vampire identify and bind Kodolaag and Olrich while Zita escapes into the crowd, and Lucinka later tells the three that they can never return to their old lives and should form a troupe in the undercity.
